# Persian Motion Director

Direct professional motion design with correct Persian/Farsi and right-to-left typography, in Remotion or plain web code: an anti-slideshow method (one camera, objects that carry across scenes, music first and cuts locked to the beat), eight ready techniques with live sketches, HarfBuzz tooling for per-letter and per-dot Persian animation, kashida stretching instead of letter-spacing, and a Persian correctness checklist and linter.
